description: Back BOTH settings stores with the shared SQLite app.db, reusing AppDatabase (no second helper, no EF, bible.db stays separate). Each store is ONE logical record stored as a single-row table with the whole object serialized to a JSON text column: AppSettings(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(Id=1), DataJson TEXT NOT NULL) and PresenterSettings(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(Id=1), DataJson TEXT NOT NULL). Column promotion is deliberately NOT done (no per-field queries exist). Defensive one-time, non-duplicating import of the sibling legacy JSON when the row is absent (tolerate missing/malformed -> defaults, never throw); after migration stop writing JSON and leave existing JSON files on disk. Enums serialized as string names inside the JSON column. Public API (Settings/LoadAsync/SaveAsync) is preserved. Depends on FEAT-001 (the single PresenterSettingsService must exist first).
steps: Modify WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/SettingsService.cs: change ctor to SettingsService(string? databasePath = null) defaulting to AppDatabase.DefaultPath (mirror MediaLibraryService.cs:84-93); build `new AppDatabase(path)`; derive legacy json path = Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(path),"settings.json"). Add `const string CreateSchemaSql = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS AppSettings (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (Id = 1), DataJson TEXT NOT NULL);"`, an `_initialized` guard, and EnsureInitializedAsync() that EnsureDirectory + runs schema DDL + ImportLegacyJsonIfNeededAsync(connection), copying the shape of SongUsageService.cs:181-262. LoadAsync: EnsureInitializedAsync, SELECT DataJson FROM AppSettings WHERE Id=1; if a row exists deserialize into Settings else keep defaults. SaveAsync: upsert the single row (INSERT INTO AppSettings(Id,DataJson) VALUES(1,@j) ON CONFLICT(Id) DO UPDATE SET DataJson=@j) with JsonSerializer.Serialize(Settings, options). Import: when the row is absent AND settings.json sibling exists, read+deserialize+write the row once (empty-row guard makes it non-duplicating); tolerate missing/malformed and never throw. Preserve the auto-create-on-missing behavior by writing a defaults row when neither row nor legacy file exists. Keep the enums-as-strings JsonSerializerOptions (WriteIndented + JsonStringEnumConverter).

Modify WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/PresenterSettingsService.cs (from FEAT-001) the same way: ctor PresenterSettingsService(string? databasePath = null) default AppDatabase.DefaultPath; `const string CreateSchemaSql` for PresenterSettings(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(Id=1), DataJson TEXT NOT NULL); EnsureInitializedAsync schema-init + one-time import of sibling presenter-settings.json (non-duplicating empty-row guard, tolerant, never throws); LoadAsync SELECT row; SaveAsync upsert row. Keep the public API and canonical options from FEAT-001.

Update construction sites to pass the shared app.db path instead of JSON paths. In MainWindow.xaml.cs: SettingsService at :55-60 -> new SettingsService(Path.Combine(appFolder,"app.db")); the PresenterSettingsService built in FEAT-001 -> new PresenterSettingsService(Path.Combine(appFolder,"app.db")) (the same appDbPath PresenterIntegration.cs:111 already uses). Keep LoadAsync()/SaveAsync() call sites intact. In PresenterIntegration.cs no path change is needed if MainWindow owns construction; if PresenterIntegration constructs it, use the existing appDbPath local (:111-112).

Update WorshipPlayer.Tests/PresenterSettingsServiceTests.cs (from FEAT-001) to inject a temp app.db and clear pools in teardown: mirror SongUsageServiceTests.cs:22-48 (temp folder, _dbPath=Path.Combine(folder,"app.db"), Dispose calls SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() then deletes the folder with an IOException-tolerant catch). Add import tests: write a legacy presenter-settings.json beside a fresh temp app.db, construct the service, assert values imported once; a SECOND instance on the same db does NOT duplicate (still single logical record, additive E5/J4 fields intact); malformed legacy json -> defaults, no throw. Keep the round-trip and single-save-path tests, now DB-backed (reopen a fresh service on the same app.db).

Add WorshipPlayer.Tests/SettingsServiceTests.cs (NEW — there is no existing SettingsService store test). Inject temp app.db, ClearAllPools in teardown. Cover: defaults when no row/file; save->reload round-trip through a fresh instance on the same db (incl. SongsFolder/SetlistsFolder values); one-time non-duplicating import of a legacy settings.json (second instance = no duplication); malformed legacy settings.json -> defaults, no throw; enum fields OutputMode/JumpTiming round-trip as string names inside DataJson.
acceptance_criteria: SettingsService and PresenterSettingsService both construct an AppDatabase, create their single-row table via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, and read/write the whole object as a JSON text column in row Id=1; no second db helper and no EF introduced; bible.db untouched.

Each store imports its sibling legacy JSON exactly once when the row is absent, tolerates missing/malformed input without throwing, and does not re-import on a second construction against the same app.db.
Additive E5/J4 fields (ScriptureShowReference, ScriptureShowTranslationName, CcliLicenseNumber) survive import and round-trip; AppSettings enum fields round-trip as string names.
Public API is unchanged (Settings property + LoadAsync + SaveAsync on both services); MainWindow and PresenterIntegration construct the services against app.db.

dotnet build succeeds (0 errors) and the full test suite passes, including the new SettingsServiceTests and the DB-backed PresenterSettingsServiceTests, with no regression in Phase-1/2/3 SQLite tests.
verification: dotnet test WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln --filter FullyQualifiedName~SettingsServiceTests  -> all pass.
dotnet test WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln --filter FullyQualifiedName~PresenterSettingsServiceTests  -> all pass (now DB-backed).
dotnet test WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln  -> full suite passes (parity, no service-orders/songs regression).
findings:
DONE. Build 0 errors (4 known pre-existing warnings: MediaLibraryPanel._currentView CS0414, ChordChartWindow CS8604, WaveformEditorWindow._inReviewMode CS0414). dotnet test --filter ~SettingsServiceTests => 11/11 (matches BOTH SettingsServiceTests 5 + PresenterSettingsServiceTests 6). Full suite: 601/601 passing, no regressions.

BOTH stores now SQLite-backed via AppDatabase (shared app.db), each a single-row DataJson table:
- SettingsService.cs: ctor SettingsService(string? databasePath = null) -> AppDatabase.DefaultPath; table AppSettings(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(Id=1), DataJson TEXT NOT NULL). _initialized guard + EnsureInitializedAsync (EnsureDirectory, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, ImportLegacyJsonIfNeededAsync). LoadAsync SELECTs row Id=1 (deserialize or defaults). SaveAsync upserts (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(Id) DO UPDATE). Legacy sibling settings.json imported once when row absent (RowExists guard, tolerant, never throws). PRESERVED the old auto-create-on-missing behavior: when neither row nor legacy file exists, a DEFAULTS row is written in EnsureInitializedAsync (SettingsService.LoadAsync historically auto-wrote defaults). Settings keeps { get; private set; }. Enums-as-strings via WriteIndented + JsonStringEnumConverter.
- PresenterSettingsService.cs: ctor PresenterSettingsService(string? databasePath = null) -> AppDatabase.DefaultPath; table PresenterSettings(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(Id=1), DataJson TEXT NOT NULL). Same EnsureInitializedAsync/LoadAsync/SaveAsync/import shape. Does NOT auto-write a defaults row on a missing store (presenter settings never auto-created one — matches FEAT-001). Settings keeps PUBLIC setter (required by PresenterIntegration single-writer delegation). Canonical options kept: WriteIndented + JsonStringEnumConverter + PropertyNameCaseInsensitive.

CONSTRUCTION SITES (MainWindow.xaml.cs MainWindow_Loaded): introduced one local `var appDbPath = Path.Combine(appFolder, "app.db");` at :57. `_settingsService = new SettingsService(appDbPath)` (:58, replaced the settings.json path). `_presenterSettingsService = new PresenterSettingsService(appDbPath)` (:175, replaced presenter-settings.json). LoadAsync()/SaveAsync() call sites unchanged. PresenterIntegration.cs needed NO change (MainWindow owns construction and injects the service + its .Settings; the appDbPath local at PresenterIntegration.cs:111 for SongUsage/Media/Alert is unaffected).

TESTS: PresenterSettingsServiceTests.cs rewritten DB-backed (temp app.db under GetTempPath, Dispose => SqliteConnection.ClearAllPools() then IOException-tolerant folder delete). Covers defaults-no-row (fresh reopen still defaults => no auto-write), malformed-legacy => defaults no-throw, additive E5/J4 + NDI/remote/shortcut round-trip, single-save-path identity, legacy-import-once + second-instance-no-duplicate. NEW SettingsServiceTests.cs (same temp-db + ClearAllPools discipline): defaults, SongsFolder/SetlistsFolder round-trip, enum OutputMode/DefaultJumpTiming stored as string names in DataJson (asserted by reading the DataJson column directly), legacy settings.json import-once + no-duplicate, malformed-legacy => defaults no-throw.

NOTE for integration/finalize: no second db helper, no EF, bible.db untouched. The legacy settings.json at repo ROOT is NOT the runtime store (runtime stores live beside app.db under BaseDirectory) and was not touched. SaveAsync does real async SQLite I/O; PresenterIntegration still calls it via GetAwaiter().GetResult() from the UI save callback (FEAT-001 note) — fine on that fire-after-change path.
